research_method: manual (no Booksy/GlossGenius/Fresha page found; business has no booking platform)
name: Robin's Grooming Headquarters
phone_note: Multiple aggregators (dogdog.org, yellowpages.com, petgroominginfo.com) agree on (239) 573-1622; one source (loc8nearme) showed (239) 989-6373 instead. Went with the number corroborated by more independent sources.
reviews_count_note: Sources ranged 53-63 (dogdog.org/loc8nearme ~53-55, Birdeye 63). Rating of 4.6 was consistent across every source. Used 55 as the most repeated figure.
instagram_note: The @robins.petgrooming handle found in search is a different business (Washington state area code in its bio, 8 followers). No confirmed Instagram exists for this Cape Coral business.
website_candidates: robinsgrooming.com (parked/for-sale domain, not the business's site)
services_note: No public price list found. Site uses the 'quoted per dog' adapted variant instead of published prices.

reviews_used.author: Ron Low
reviews_used.body: I'm so glad we found Robin. She is a magician with little dogs.

reviews_used.author: Paige Mincieli
reviews_used.body: Robin is this best groomer in the entire universe! My Havanese/Poodle literally runs in the door to see her.

reviews_used.author: Paul Taglieri
reviews_used.body: This is a great place & it's the owner who does the only grooming. Much better than going to a place that has multiple groomers!

reviews_used.author: Patty Briskin
reviews_used.body: Robin was fantastic, not only was she sweet to my 2 dogs but to me as well. My dogs never looked better.
reviews_used.source: Birdeye aggregation, unconfirmed original platform (not used on site, kept as backup)

photos_source: loc8nearme.com listing page (localdatacdn.com CDN, appears to mirror Google Business Profile photos). 22 candidate photos downloaded and visually curated: excluded a photo showing a child, a multi-image collage, a phone-screenshot with UI chrome, a photo with a visible cigarette/ashtray, and several mid-groom/wet-dog shots with eyes obscured per curation rules. 10 clean photos kept, 10 used in the final build.
